intros ht_int_pos ht_int_neg
have h_exp_pos : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) = Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) ∨ Real.exp (-t * X ω) = Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) := by
  intro ω
  rw [abs_mul, abs_t]
  split_ifs
  · left
    rw [Real.exp_neg_eq_inv_exp, Real.exp_neg_eq_inv_exp]
    simp only [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg]
  · right
    rw [Real.exp_neg_eq_inv_exp, Real.exp_neg_eq_inv_exp]
    simp only [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg]
have h_exp_pos_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)) μ :=
  by
    apply MeasureTheory.integrable_sum
    apply MeasureTheory.integrable_add
    exact ht_int_pos
    exact ht_int_neg
exact h_exp_pos_int
